product.name: Slim Fit Lightweight Puffer Jacket
product.description: Lightweight, slim-fit puffer jacket in quilted, woven fabric with a fitted silhouette. Hood, zipper at front with anti-chafe chin guard, long sleeves, and side-seam pockets with a concealed zipper. Elasticized binding at hood, cuffs, and hem. Unlined.
